acquisition method: Data collection on the Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer was performed in a data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode of acquisition
alkylation reagent: reduced for 15 min at 80°C with 10 mM dithiothreitol, and alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature.
alkylation concentration: reduced for 15 min at 80°C with 10 mM dithiothreitol, and alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature.
cleavage agent: digested using 20 ng/µL sequencing grade trypsin (Promega) for 1 h at 47°C
collision energy: HCD collision energy setting of 27% was used for all MS2 scans.
enrichment method: we selected four substructures of SChLAP1 for biotin pulldowns followed by mass spectrometry protein identification
fragmentation method: HCD collision energy setting of 27% was used for all MS2 scans.
instrument: LC/MS/MS was performed using an EvoSep One UPLC coupled to a Thermo Orbitrap Astral high-resolution accurate mass tandem mass spectrometer (Thermo).
labeling: We submitted the eluates of the four RNA pulldown samples for analysis via qualitative proteomics.
reduction reagent: reduced for 15 min at 80°C with 10 mM dithiothreitol
reduction concentration: reduced for 15 min at 80°C with 10 mM dithiothreitol
